answer: Make every agent identity carry a costly, verifiable work history: before an agent can transact at full weight, it must build a long trail of peer-attested useful work, so a fresh fake starts at the nadir of trust and climbs only slowly. Sybils then face the same math as repainting a house with a single drop of pigment - faking a rich history costs more than one scam returns. A sable badge marking long-standing, attested agents lets others spot trusted counterparts at a glance, so cheap identities stay visible, slow, and unprofitable.
